🎬 127 Hours (2010)

127 Hours tells the extraordinary true story of Aron Ralston, an adventurous young mountain climber whose passion for exploring the wilderness leads him into a terrifying fight for survival. While hiking alone through the remote canyons of Utah, Aron experiences a devastating accident when a falling boulder traps his right arm against a canyon wall, leaving him completely immobilized with no way to call for help. With limited food, water, and supplies, he quickly realizes that nobody knows his exact location and that rescue may never arrive. As the hours turn into days, Aron battles extreme dehydration, exhaustion, physical pain, and the overwhelming fear of dying alone. Trapped in the unforgiving desert landscape, he begins reflecting on his relationships, past decisions, and the people he wishes he could see again. Through memories, hallucinations, and moments of emotional clarity, Aron discovers how much he has taken life and human connection for granted. With his strength fading and options disappearing, he must confront an unimaginable decision that will test the limits of his courage and determination. Featuring an unforgettable performance by James Franco, breathtaking cinematography, intense suspense, and powerful emotional storytelling, 127 Hours explores survival, resilience, isolation, regret, hope, and the extraordinary strength of the human spirit when faced with seemingly impossible circumstances.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Adventure • Drama • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 7.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 34m • R

🎥 Director: Danny Boyle

✍️ Writers: Danny Boyle & Simon Beaufoy

📖 Based on: Between a Rock and a Hard Place by Aron Ralston
